safeguards.requirement: Risk analysis and risk management.
safeguards.plain: MOATiT runs a documented risk analysis and risk management program, with yearly vulnerability scans and penetration tests.
safeguards.technical: Organizational, covered by MOATiT policy (annual scanning and penetration testing).

safeguards.requirement: Regularly review records of information system activity.
safeguards.plain: Drawbridge keeps an audit log of every phone-agent request, every request it sends to Veradigm® EHR and Veradigm® PM, every staff screen opened and every staff action. The Activity screen shows the day’s activity and security events for review.
safeguards.technical: Audit lines for kinds tool / action / view / staff / security; staff access middleware on every module screen; Activity screen with a Security events panel ("to review" count).

safeguards.requirement: End access when a workforce member leaves.
safeguards.plain: Removing a person’s login signs them out everywhere at once, and an old session never comes back even if the same name is added again.
safeguards.technical: Users file re-read on change; a removed user or changed password revokes all sessions (persisted revocation list).

safeguards.requirement: Authorize, establish and change access based on role.
safeguards.plain: Every staff member has their own login with a role. Only administrators (the privacy or security officer) can run the access and disclosure report. Drawbridge itself can call only a fixed list of Veradigm® actions.
safeguards.technical: Users file roles staff / admin / emergency; requireAdmin on the access report; fixed Unity action list (UNITY_ACTIONS_FOR_CERTIFICATION.md).

safeguards.requirement: Security awareness and training for the workforce.
safeguards.plain: Every MOATiT staff member completes HIPAA security and privacy training every year.
safeguards.technical: Organizational, covered by MOATiT policy.

safeguards.requirement: Protection from malicious software.
safeguards.plain: MOATiT servers run managed endpoint detection and response (EDR), and patches are applied through managed patching with critical patches within 7 days.
safeguards.technical: Organizational, covered by MOATiT policy (SentinelOne EDR; ConnectWise ScreenConnect RMM patching).

safeguards.requirement: Monitor log-in attempts and report discrepancies.
safeguards.plain: Every sign-in, failed sign-in and lockout is recorded as a security event. Five wrong tries lock a login for 15 minutes, and too many failures from one computer lock that computer.
safeguards.technical: Security events login_ok / login_failed (reason) / login_locked / login_ip_locked; lockout per username (5 in 15 min) and per IP (30).

safeguards.requirement: Procedures for creating, changing and safeguarding passwords.
safeguards.plain: Passwords must be at least 12 characters and not common or guessable. They expire every 90 days, and none of the last 5 passwords can be reused. Passwords are stored only as strong one-way hashes.
safeguards.technical: passwordProblem policy; DRAWBRIDGE_PASSWORD_MAX_AGE_DAYS (90) with :pwset=; :hist= keeps 4 previous hashes, staff:user refuses reuse of the last 5; scrypt.

safeguards.requirement: Identify security incidents (detection and documentation).
safeguards.plain: Drawbridge raises security events for repeated failed sign-ins, lockouts, emergency access, rejected connection keys, documents that no longer match what was received, and unusually many downloads or patient records opened by one person.
safeguards.technical: security-events.ts: [SECURITY] server-log lines plus audit lines; throttled tool_key_rejected / webhook_rejected; integrity_failed; export_volume_alert and view_volume_alert (DRAWBRIDGE_EXPORT_ALERT_PER_HOUR 20, DRAWBRIDGE_VIEW_ALERT_PER_HOUR 200).

safeguards.requirement: Respond to and report security incidents.
safeguards.plain: MOATiT has a written incident response plan, including breach notification to clients under the Business Associate Agreement.
safeguards.technical: Organizational, covered by MOATiT policy. Alerting on [SECURITY] log lines is a deployment item.

safeguards.requirement: Data backup plan.
safeguards.plain: Drawbridge’s working data is backed up every 2 hours, kept 6 months, encrypted and immutable. After a restore, the audit log’s tamper check is run.
safeguards.technical: Back up the data volume (call records, intake store, audit day files, revocation list); encrypted, immutable; npm run audit:verify -- --all after a restore.

safeguards.requirement: Disaster recovery and emergency mode operation.
safeguards.plain: MOATiT has written disaster recovery and business continuity plans. If Drawbridge or Veradigm® is unavailable, the phone agent says it is having trouble and offers to transfer or take a message (it never says “nothing on file”), and staff keep working in Veradigm® EHR, which remains the system of record.
safeguards.technical: Failures are { success:false, error_code, retryable } (CLAUDE.md rule 5); DR/BCP organizational.

safeguards.requirement: Periodic technical and non-technical evaluation.
safeguards.plain: Yearly vulnerability scanning and penetration testing by an outside firm, plus automated security tests run on every change to Drawbridge.
safeguards.technical: Organizational (annual scan and pen test); offline smoke suites in the repo.

safeguards.requirement: Facility access and workstation security.
safeguards.plain: Production runs on MOATiT-managed infrastructure in US data centers (a cloud provider under a BAA, or MOATiT’s own data center), with physical access controls.
safeguards.technical: Organizational / hosting provider.

safeguards.requirement: Dispose of ePHI securely.
safeguards.plain: Drawbridge deletes its working copies on a schedule: call records and outreach lists after 30 days, received documents 30 days after they are filed, patient details on filed document records after 90 days, and shadow-week copies that were never filed after 30 days (or at once when the shadow week ends). Storage is encrypted, so destroying the encryption key erases everything for good.
safeguards.technical: Daily retention jobs (CALL_RECORDS_, OUTREACH_, INTAKE_ RETENTION_DAYS 30; INTAKE_RECORD_RETENTION_DAYS 90; INTAKE_SHADOW_RETENTION_DAYS 30, and npm run intake:purge-shadow at go-live or switch-off); crypto-erase of the encrypted volume at end of life.

safeguards.requirement: Remove ePHI before media is re-used.
safeguards.plain: Disks are never re-used with data on them: an encrypted volume is destroyed with its key and a new one is created.
safeguards.technical: AWS: delete the EBS volume and snapshots (KMS key schedule); data center: cryptsetup luksErase / BitLocker key destruction (NIST SP 800-88 crypto-erase).

safeguards.requirement: Track hardware and media; back up data before moving equipment.
safeguards.plain: MOATiT keeps an inventory of its servers and takes an encrypted backup before any equipment is moved.
safeguards.technical: Organizational / deployment.

safeguards.requirement: Access control: only authorized people and programs can reach ePHI.
safeguards.plain: Every staff screen needs a sign-in. The connections used by the phone agent need a secret key and refuse every request when it is missing; the phone agent has its own key that opens nothing but its own tools.
safeguards.technical: requireLogin on every module router; requireToolKey fails closed (503) and rejects wrong keys (401, security event); requireAgentKey: DRAWBRIDGE_AGENT_KEY opens POST /api/retell only (falls back to the tool key when unset).

safeguards.requirement: Access control on patient calls: the phone agent can open only the records of callers it has verified.
safeguards.plain: On every phone call, Drawbridge itself checks identity before any record is opened: a patient’s record can be used only after the caller gave that patient’s exact full name and date of birth and exactly one patient matched, on that same call (a near spelling is read back and searched again before anything is shared). At most two people can be verified per call (for example a parent calling for a child), and repeated lookups on one call are stopped and reported as a security alert. Staff screens are not affected.
safeguards.technical: Per-call verification binding keyed by the Retell call ID (call-binding.ts, both agent endpoints): unity_search_patients / verify_patient_identity with first + last name + DOB and one match whose names and DOB equal what was given binds that patient’s IDs to the call (variants are read back, never bound; same name + DOB patients never merged) (memory only, DRAWBRIDGE_CALL_BINDING_TTL_MIN 120); every patient-scoped tool and appointment ID needs a bound patient, else NOT_VERIFIED; no call ID = CALL_ID_MISSING; DRAWBRIDGE_CALL_MAX_VERIFIED_PATIENTS 2, DRAWBRIDGE_CALL_MAX_SEARCHES 5; refusals are security events.

safeguards.requirement: Unique user identification.
safeguards.plain: Every person signs in with their own named login. No shared logins are allowed in production.
safeguards.technical: Named users file; the shared DRAWBRIDGE_USERNAME login works only in development with TOTP off and is refused in production.

safeguards.requirement: Emergency access procedure.
safeguards.plain: A sealed emergency login exists for when no named login can be used. Using it raises an alert, shows a warning on every page, ends after 4 hours, and is reviewed by the privacy officer afterwards. Veradigm® EHR remains the system of record for patient care.
safeguards.technical: role=emergency: emergency_access_login security event, banner, 4-hour absolute limit; procedure in this document.

safeguards.requirement: Automatic logoff.
safeguards.plain: Staff are signed out after 15 minutes without activity, and the screen clears itself at that moment so no patient information is left showing. Every session ends after 12 hours regardless.
safeguards.technical: Server idle timeout (DRAWBRIDGE_IDLE_MINUTES 15, sliding) and 12-hour limit; pages carry data-idle-ms and blank themselves.

safeguards.requirement: Automatic logoff in the separate admin console.
safeguards.plain: The separate administration console must apply the same sign-out rules.
safeguards.technical: The admin portal is a separate application (not in this repository); it must implement idle logoff, MFA and the same session rules.

safeguards.requirement: Encryption of stored ePHI.
safeguards.plain: All Drawbridge data is kept on encrypted volumes (AES), and backups are encrypted too. Disk encryption is verified for every deployment before go-live.
safeguards.technical: Deployment: EBS encryption with KMS (infra owned by the infrastructure team; compute.tf root_block_device needs encrypted = true); data center: BitLocker or LUKS2. Files are written mode 0600 in 0700 directories.

safeguards.requirement: Audit controls that record and examine activity.
safeguards.plain: The audit log records who did what and when, for which patient (by ID, never by name), is tamper-evident, and is kept for 6 years.
safeguards.technical: Hash-chained JSONL day files (audit:verify); staff views and actions with user and patient ID; AUDIT_RETENTION_DAYS default 2190 (6 years); off-host archive is a deployment item.

safeguards.requirement: Integrity: protect ePHI from improper change and detect it.
safeguards.plain: Each received document gets a digital fingerprint when it arrives. Drawbridge checks it again before anyone downloads the document and before it is filed to the chart; a mismatch stops the action and raises an alert.
safeguards.technical: SHA-256 at receipt; verified before download (409) and before SaveScanDocument (INTEGRITY_FAILED); audit hash chain; atomic file writes; idempotent writes.

safeguards.requirement: Person or entity authentication.
safeguards.plain: Every staff sign-in needs a password and a one-time code from an authenticator app. Systems that connect to Drawbridge must present a secret key or a signature.
safeguards.technical: TOTP mandatory (DRAWBRIDGE_REQUIRE_TOTP default on, forced in production); tool key and the phone agent’s own key (DRAWBRIDGE_AGENT_KEY); HMAC-signed MOATiT Fax and Retell webhooks.

safeguards.requirement: Transmission security and integrity in transit.
safeguards.plain: Everything travels encrypted (HTTPS). Drawbridge refuses to start in production if a Veradigm® connection is not encrypted, and browsers are told to use HTTPS only.
safeguards.technical: Production refuses non-https Unity/FHIR/MOATiT Fax URLs; HSTS; __Host- Secure cookie; signed webhooks.

safeguards.requirement: Encryption in transit at the network edge.
safeguards.plain: Public connections accept only TLS 1.2 or 1.3 with valid certificates, and plain HTTP is redirected to HTTPS.
safeguards.technical: Deployment: TLS 1.2+ termination in nginx / the tunnel; ports 3000/3001 never exposed directly.

safeguards.requirement: Business associate agreements, including with subcontractors.
safeguards.plain: MOATiT signs a BAA with each clinic. Every subcontractor that handles PHI (hosting, voice platform) is under a signed BAA too.
safeguards.technical: Organizational. Any other service that sees PHI in clear (for example a TLS-terminating tunnel or CDN) also needs a BAA.

safeguards.requirement: Report security incidents to the covered entity.
safeguards.plain: Security events and the access report give MOATiT what it needs to tell a clinic quickly what happened and which patients were involved.
safeguards.technical: Security events + access report per patient / per staff user support the report; the reporting duty is organizational.

safeguards.requirement: Minimum necessary.
safeguards.plain: The phone agent receives only what it needs: name, date of birth and record IDs after the caller is identified. It never gets addresses, phone numbers, email or Social Security numbers, a name-only or partial search reveals no one, and staff-only lists (the day’s schedule) are never available on patient calls. Logs never contain patient names or chart contents.
safeguards.technical: forAgent() at the agent edges (Retell, MCP, stdio); STAFF_ONLY tools refused; audit and server logs hold IDs and codes only.

safeguards.requirement: Accounting of disclosures.
safeguards.plain: Administrators can list every Drawbridge record that touched one patient (or everything one staff member did) for any date range, on screen or as a spreadsheet, to prepare an accounting of disclosures.
safeguards.technical: Access and disclosure report (admin, POST, HTML/CSV), backed by the 6-year audit log.

safeguards.requirement: Reasonable safeguards against improper use or disclosure.
safeguards.plain: Patient details never appear in web addresses or page titles, pages are not cached or framed, and patient-specific searches are sent in the page body.
safeguards.technical: POST for patient IDs and free-text questions; neutral titles; Cache-Control no-store, CSP, X-Frame-Options DENY, Referrer-Policy no-referrer; state-changing staff requests must be same-origin (Sec-Fetch-Site / Origin, 403 + cross_site_request); FHIR REST test routes off in production.

safeguards.requirement: Keep required documentation for 6 years.
safeguards.plain: The audit log is kept for 6 years by default.
safeguards.technical: AUDIT_RETENTION_DAYS default 2190; copy day files to append-only archive storage (deployment).

safeguards.requirement: Support breach detection, investigation and notification.
safeguards.plain: Security events help detect a possible breach, the tamper-evident audit log and the access report show which patients were affected, and MOATiT notifies the clinic under the BAA.
safeguards.technical: Detection (security events, alerts), scoping (access report per patient / per user), tamper evidence (hash chain); notification is organizational.

organizational_safeguards: Annual HIPAA security and privacy training for all staff.
Written incident response plan, including breach notification to clients under the Business Associate Agreement.
Written disaster recovery and business continuity plans.
Backups every 2 hours, kept for 6 months, encrypted and immutable.
Managed endpoint detection and response (EDR) on all servers.
Patching through managed remote monitoring and management; critical patches within 7 days after in-house testing.
Vulnerability scanning and penetration testing every year by an independent firm.
Production on MOATiT-managed infrastructure in the US (a cloud provider under a Business Associate Agreement, or MOATiT’s own data center), with encrypted storage.
A Business Associate Agreement signed with each client.
Voice platform under a Business Associate Agreement.
Multi-factor sign-in (authenticator app codes) for every user.
SOC 2: in process; audit to be completed before the end of 2027.
